notes.title: Support us on Kickstarter
notes.content:
Hi Sir! 
We want to inform you that we have a[b] Kickstarter campaign[/b] right now, and it will be open until [b]June 27 2020 11:13 PM CEST.[/b]
You can pledge for a [b]Nintendo Switch[/b] version, the AOT official [b]Game Board[/b] and much more.

For more information visit the [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/577961910/angels-on-tanks-a-turn-based-strategy-game-board-game]Kickstarter page[/url].

We are [b]157% funded[/b]! We won the battle, help us to win the the war!
